content.title: 76ers vs. Spurs: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (4/6/26)
content.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (43–35) face the San Antonio Spurs (59–19) tonight at Frost Bank Center in a critical, cross-conference matchup for playoff seeding. The Sixers enter tonight positioned for the sixth and final automatic playoff spot, separated from the seventh-place Toronto Raptors by just a tiebreaker. The Charlotte Hornets are just a half-game behind, and the Orlando Magic are an additional half-game back. A loss would push Philly into play-in tournament territory, with just three games left in the season to make the move back up. The Spurs, meanwhile, are now three games out of the top spot in the West, trailing the defending champion Oklahoma City Thunder. Both teams have four games left — and, critically, the Spurs own the tiebreaker. So there’s still a pathway for San Antonio to the top, but it’ll require OKC to lose at least three games. The 76ers are coming off a 116–93 loss to the Detroit Pistons — a game in which they trailed most of the way and were held to just 33 points in the second half. Tyrese Maxey, Paul George, and VJ Edgecombe all scored 19 or more, but with Joel Embiid sidelined, Philly was simply not positioned to take on the East’s top team. The Spurs, meanwhile, are coming off a 136–134 overtime loss to the Denver Nuggets. Victor Wembanyama delivered 34 points and 18 rebounds in a high-level performance, and all five San Antonio starters scored 14 points or more, but they fell in a battle of endurance with another Western Conference titan. Expect a tight one with Embiid returning to the lineup, but the Spurs will edge out the Sixers. Though it’s a cross-conference matchup, consider it a litmus test for how deep Philly can go in the postseason at full strength. Final Score Prediction: San Antonio Spurs 118, Philadelphia 76ers 115 Injury Report Philadelphia 76ers Cameron Payne — Out (Hamstring) Johni Broome — Out (Knee) San Antonio Spurs Emanuel Miller — GTD David Jones-Garcia — Out (Ankle) How to Watch 76ers vs. Spurs Tip-off for tonight’s Philadelphia 76ers-San Antonio Spurs game is set for 8:00 PM Eastern / 7:00 PM Central at Frost Bank Center in San Antonio.
